rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for both a broad summary and “in effect.”

example.english: This job is essentially sitting in front of a computer every day.
example.traditional: 呢份工基本上就係日日對住部電腦。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 gei1 bun2 soeng6 zau6 hai6 jat6 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 bou6 din6 nou5

rows.note: Use this when you mean something is true in its intrinsic nature or essence, rather than merely true in practical terms.

example.english: This plant is essentially a parasitic plant.
example.traditional: 呢種植物本質上係寄生植物。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 zik6 mat6 bun2 zat1 soeng6 hai6 gei3 sang1 zik6 mat6
